'''Yurka Aggel''' was an elderly [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Nazren]], who lived during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and worked as a healer.

==Biography==
Aggel lived on [[Nizon]], where she was a healer and considered a "wise woman" by the other Nazren. When the Empire came to Nizon, she witnessed her people becoming [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]], so she was pleased when they [[Battle of Nizon|rose up]] against the Empire. During the battle, she gave a group of [[Alderaanian Resistance]] agents shelter in her house, after they were cornered by the advancing Imperial forces. However, some [[LM-432 crab droid/Legends|LM-432 crab droids]] that were working for [[Vril Vrakth]], a [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]], burrowed into her house to attack the agents.<ref name="The First to Strike" />
